selection_rule: source episodes in source-file order starting right after the last episode read by the Stage 1B conversion (position 130); a window of 420 is converted with the Stage 1B command and flags; the first 400 that pass the same replay success filter are adopted, the later ones are recorded as unused. Fewer than the required number stops the stage; the window is not extended silently.
loader_rule: upstream load_traj_hdf5 sorts traj_<id> numerically and takes the first num_demos; this file holds exactly ids 0..N-1
initial_state_source: source trajectory.h5, env_states[0] of the source episode (not the converted file env_states[0])

first_success.note: Recorded before training. Such demonstrations are kept: the success filter and the horizon are unchanged.

first_env_state_note.meaning: cube state of the converted env_states[0] against the first and the second source state; the converted value is not used as the initial scene
